subject: Pool modulation & annual pricing review
body:
From: Michael Thorp <michael.thorp@astra-ml.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 20 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pool modulation & annual pricing review

Hannah,

We're coming up on our Dedicated renewal and evaluating whether to expand the pool mid-term. Current environment: 20x A100 (40GB) reserved GPUs, committed baseline throughput for our main LLM workload (mix of 4k and 32k contexts) — we typically need ~1.2M tokens/min sustained across peak hours. Performance has been solid but we expect increased production load in Q3.

Two asks from our side:
- Can you provide a priced option for a phased uplift: +8 GPUs now (mid-term), +12 GPUs at renewal (12 months)? Include prorated billing and exact SLA/throughput guarantees per tier.
- Budget constraints: we can increase commitment but only if the blended unit price stays <= 0.85x our current per-GPU effective cost. Any flexibility on stepped discounts or credits for the mid-term add?

Attaching a quick spreadsheet with our utilization snapshots.

Thanks,
Michael
Michael Thorp
Head of Platform, Astra ML

---
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
To: Michael Thorp <michael.thorp@astra-ml.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 20 Apr 2027 10:03:12 -0700
Subject: Re: Pool modulation & annual pricing review

Michael — thanks for the clear brief and the utilization sheet. High level proposal attached (Redwood_Pool_Modulation_Prices_v4.xlsx) but summary below:

Option A — Phased uplift (recommended)
- Mid-term add: +8x H100-80GB equiv (we price H100 uplift at a ~1.4x factor vs A100 capacity, see note)
- Renewal add: +12x (convert to uniform H100 pool or hybrid based on final models)
- Commercial: mid-term addition billed pro rata for remainder of the term at a 6% uplift on list for isolated mid-term adds (to cover rebalancing). If you commit to the +12 at renewal (12 months), we can drop the mid-term uplift surcharge and apply a 10% blended discount across the full commit for the 12-month renewal.
- Throughput guarantees: we can guarantee token throughput at a per-GPU contribution model (attached calc). For your reported load, the +8 mid-term will provide ~35% headroom for typical Q3 peaks with H100s.

Option B — Renewal-only restructure
- Move to a single committed pool of 40 GPUs at renewal with a 12% discount vs current blended. No mid-term change.

Next steps: if you'd like I can loop in Marissa on commercial terms and Karthik for the workload profiling to ensure the H100 conversion maps to your models.

Best,
Hannah Schmitt
Account Executive — Redwood Inference

-----Original Message-----
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>; Michael Thorp <michael.thorp@astra-ml.com>
Date: Wed, 21 Apr 2027 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pool modulation & annual pricing review

Adding a few technical notes so the commercial math is grounded:

On H100 vs A100 sizing
- For the family of models Astra runs (opt-66B/70B and some fine-tuned 13B ensembles) we see ~1.25-1.6x throughput improvement moving to H100s when using optimized kernels and FP8/4-bit quantization paths. That means fewer H100 GPUs to meet the same token/s target vs A100s — but memory-constrained workloads (32k context) still favor A100-40GB for certain model variants unless you use sequence-slicing.

Throughput guarantee calculation (summary)
- We model per-GPU sustained token/sec using your 7-day p95 request mix. For your 1.2M tokens/min target the math maps to: 20x A100 baseline ~= 18 A100-equivalent sustain; +8 H100s (converted) gives expected sustain of ~1.6M tokens/min with 90th percentile headroom.

Operational caveats
- Mid-term adds trigger a short rebalancing window (2-4 business days) where KV cache warmups will transiently reduce effective throughput; we provide a 48-hour burst buffer to minimize application impact.

I attached Throughput_Calc_H100_vs_A100.csv with the per-model estimates. Happy to run a short benchmark on your production snapshot if you want tighter numbers.

- Karthik
Staff Solutions Engineer — Redwood Inference

On Thu, 22 Apr 2027 14:22:37 -0700, Michael Thorp <michael.thorp@astra-ml.com> wrote:

Hannah / Karthik / team,

Appreciate the detail. A couple of follow-ups from procurement/budget:
1) Proration and mid-term economics: how do you calculate the prorated amount when adding +8 mid-term? We need a clear formula to show to finance (monthly amortized base commit + mid-term uplift factor).
2) SLA credits: our internal SRE wants to understand how guaranteed throughput maps to credits. For example, if sustained 5% below guaranteed throughput for 6 hours during a peak, what's the credit mechanism?
3) Discounting: we can accept a renewal at the 12% blended discount if we get a 1) a one-time onboarding credit of $20k for the mid-term rebalancing and 2) a guarantee that the blended per-GPU effective price after mid-term add does not exceed 0.9x our current effective price.

Looping Lina Park from procurement (procurement@astra-ml.com) who will own the PO and invoicing calendar.

Thanks,
Michael

-----
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Michael Thorp <michael.thorp@astra-ml.com>; Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 26 Apr 2027 09:30:05 -0700
Subject: Re: Pool modulation & annual pricing review

Michael / Lina — thanks for the clear asks. Commercial response below (we've replicated the numbers in the attached spreadsheet):

Proration formula (applies to mid-term add)
- Prorated charge = (Monthly unit price * #GPUs_added) * (remaining_days_in_term / days_in_billing_month) * mid_term_surcharge_factor
- For bookkeeping we agree to use a 30-day month for internal finance workflows unless your AP team prefers calendar days. We'll surface the invoice sketch prior to execution.

SLA / credits
- Throughput SLA is measured at the token/sec granularity across the dedicated pool, reported hourly. Credits are applied as a percentage of the monthly committed fee:
  - >=99.5% achieved: no credits
  - 99.0% - 99.49%: 5% credit of monthly committed GPU fees
  - 98.0% - 98.99%: 10% credit
  - <98.0%: 25% credit + engineering review and potential free remediation window (up to 72 hours)
- Credits are capped at 100% of the monthly committed GPU fees in extreme cases.

Discounting and credits
- We can approve the 12% blended renewal discount conditioned on:
  1) A 30% increase in committed GPU count at renewal (i.e., moving to ~40-42 GPU equivalent), and
  2) A 12-month renewal term, prepaid or monthly billed with a signed MSA addendum.
- As a commercial concession for mid-term disruption we will apply a one-time onboarding credit of $20,000 (applied against first invoice after the mid-term add clears).
- To meet your blended price ceiling request (<=0.9x current), we will apply a blended rate schedule in the renewal SOW that tiers unit pricing by GPU band. We'll share the banded price table in the DocuSign SOW.

Action items / next steps
- Hannah: send the updated SOW with banded pricing and the proration example; include a DocuSign link for signature.
- Michael / Lina: confirm billing cadence (prepay vs monthly) and whether procurement wants calendar-day proration.
- Karthik / engineering: please run a short production snapshot benchmark (48-72 hrs) once legal greenlights the SOW change.

I'll draft the SOW amendment and add the DocuSign link; we can do a final commercial call Wed next week if that works.

Regards,
Marissa Cole
Director, Customer Success & Commercials — Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Pool modulation & annual pricing review — next steps

Thanks everyone — quick confirmation of next steps from Redwood: 
1) We're updating the SOW to include: banded GPU pricing, explicit proration formula (uses 30-day month by default), the $20k onboarding credit line item, and the SLA credits table above. Draft SOW and DocuSign link will be shared by EOD tomorrow (we uploaded a working copy: https://docusign.net/rdw/ASTRA-0482).
2) Marissa will prepare an invoice sketch showing the prorated mid-term add and the blended renewal pricing scenarios.
3) Karthik to schedule the 48-72hr benchmark window once the SOW is signed; engineering will coordinate a warmup plan to minimize KV cache warm-up impact.
4) Procurement (Lina) to confirm billing cadence and PO timing — if you can confirm prepay vs monthly by Apr 30 we'll lock pricing bands.

Michael — attaching the SOW draft and priced band table; please review and Lina let us know any AP constraints. Once we have the SOW signed we'll schedule the commercial kickoff and the benchmark.

Best,
Hannah Schmitt
Account Executive — Redwood Inference

Attachments referenced: Redwood_Pool_Modulation_Prices_v4.xlsx; SOW-Dedicated-Amendment-Draft.pdf; Throughput_Calc_H100_vs_A100.csv
